bl_kind_ck.name: bl_kind_ck
bl_kind_ck.value:
("bill_lines"."purchase_order_line_id" is not null and "bill_lines"."item_id" is not null and "bill_lines"."quantity" > 0 and "bill_lines"."unit_cost" >= 0 and "bill_lines"."account_id" is null)
        or ("bill_lines"."purchase_order_line_id" is null and "bill_lines"."account_id" is not null and "bill_lines"."amount" > 0)
